Exercise callback signatures and contexts where a method cannot be inferred.

-- signatures.go --
package callbacks

type callbackStore struct{}

type Callback func(param2 int, c string, rest ...bool) (param3 int, err error)
type Register func(Callback)

func callbacks() {
	c := &callbackStore{}
	var register Register
	register(c.named)           //@quickfix("named", re"has no field or method", named)
	withFixed((c.fixed), 1, 2)  //@quickfix("fixed", re"has no field or method", fixed)
	withMany(func() {}, c.many) //@quickfix("many", re"has no field or method", many)
	withString(c.field)         //@quickfixerr("field", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	x := c.unknown              //@quickfixerr("unknown", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	_ = x
}

func withFixed(func(int) string, ...int) {}
func withMany(...func())                 {}
func withString(string)                  {}
-- @named/signatures.go --
@@ -4 +4,4 @@
+
+func (c *callbackStore) named(param2 int, param3 string, rest ...bool) (int, error) {
+	panic("unimplemented")
+}
-- @fixed/signatures.go --
@@ -4 +4,4 @@
+
+func (c *callbackStore) fixed(i int) string {
+	panic("unimplemented")
+}
-- @many/signatures.go --
@@ -4 +4,4 @@
+
+func (c *callbackStore) many() {
+	panic("unimplemented")
+}
